title: Frozen JCGS phase-gap failure attribution
purpose: Determine whether the sealed JCGS failure is caused by cardinality, seed alignment, cyclic phase, gap shape, or confidence before selecting the next GSE-Graph semantic representation.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 read-only audit of sealed JCGS C07/C08 Teacher and three-seed predictions; no training, new inference, checkpoint selection, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution, approved all in-scope operations, and delegated best-method choices without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed circular exit-geometry Teacher for C07/C08.
Sealed three-seed JCGS V1R2 development predictions.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.audit_scope: Only 20 frozen C07/C08 development worlds are read; C01-C06 are provenance-only and not read.

sampling.rule: Audit every sealed observation once. Oracle count, oracle phase, oracle gaps and target-aligned seeds are diagnosis-only upper bounds and cannot be deployed.

teacher.source: Frozen exit-center presence bins plus signed sub-bin heading residuals.
teacher.valid_mask: Every presence bin is an objective exit-bearing target; no missing value is imputed.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph or planner is executed and Teacher identity never enters a deployable prediction.

split.historical_pollution_audit: No weight, prediction or threshold is changed. Formal C07/C08 metrics are reproduced exactly before attribution.
split.selection: C07 may select only the five predeclared frozen confidence thresholds at exit precision at least 0.995.
split.transfer: Each unchanged C07 threshold is applied once to C08. Diagnosis must agree across both splits.

methods.main: Frozen-output decomposition into per-seed and ensemble cardinality confusion, oracle-count ceiling, target-aligned ensemble ceiling, phase-versus-gap oracle interventions, gap collapse and confidence separability.
methods.baseline: The exact sealed formal JCGS ensemble metrics, reproduced to machine precision.
methods.fallback: If formal reproduction or joins fail, seal system FAIL. If both phase and gap fail consistently on K>=3, replace complete-set regression with structure-event plus relational exit factorization; do not post-process or compensate in the planner.

failure_policy: Do not train, infer, relax tolerance or precision, select on C08, use oracle variables as deployment inputs, or enter graph/planner. Any source, join, count or reproduction drift stops the run.
retention: Retain compact summary, CSV tables, PNG/PDF/SVG figures and source, environment, raw logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal. Source predictions remain in their immutable training run.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only deterministic audit of 45,942 frozen observations
